name: Café de Colombia
verdict: The flagship brand of the Federación Nacional de Cafeteros de Colombia (FNC), Colombia's non-profit coffee growers' federation.
note: Official Coffee Partner of Netcompany INEOS, announced 22 April 2026; its logo is on the bib shorts of the 2026 kit. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. The FNC is a private, non-profit growers' federation, but its Comité Nacional de Cafeteros — described on the FNC's own structure page as the body where coffee policy is agreed between the federation and the government, existing because the FNC administers the National Coffee Fund (FoNC), an account of public coffee funds — includes four national-government ministers plus the members of the federation's elected Comité Directivo (claim fnc-comite-nacional-gobierno). Whether those seats count as a state board seat under METHOD is a maintainer's call. Colombia has an extensively documented record of serious abuses (including the UN-documented 'false positives' extrajudicial killings), so the tier would not be none if the link counts.
